Exactly right! Yes, live plants ship **Monday to Wednesday only**, so your replacement will go out on one of those days.

If there's a weather hold (when transit forecasts are below 35°F or above 95°F), it could be delayed up to 7 days, and we'd email you to let you know.

Once the replacement ships, tracking will be emailed to you and you can follow along.

**To get started, I just need your order number** (LF- followed by six digits, found in "My Orders" or your confirmation email). Then I'll open the courier investigation right away.

Your **$15 store credit** for the delay is also ready for you.

Thanks so much for sticking with us, and please reach out any time you need help!
